description: Land Acquisition - Pitagaldeniya, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations (Lot A and Lot B in Kurukosgahamula Watta and Galketiye Watta), making it primarily about land and property matters. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in the context of authorizing the land acquisition process, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content focuses exclusively on land acquisition details, fitting the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
